messages:
Leah P: Planning to take parental leave starting 2026-08-09. Quick practical questions: can I use remaining vacation the week before to stay paid? How does that interact with bonus / equity vesting dates falling during leave? If I come back at 0.75 FTE, will my medical coverage continue? Also who coordinates laptop pickup if I won't be in office the last day? cc @people-ops @eng-ops
Ivy (People Ops): Congrats, Leah! :party_popper: You may absolutely apply PTO right before your leave; PTO pays like normal wages. Bonus eligibility is governed by our comp plan (vesting/bonus payout schedules usually depend on payroll/award terms)  we'll ask Comp to confirm if any pro-rating applies for your specific bonus. Regarding equity vesting dates during leave: standard practice is that time on unpaid leave may pause vesting depending on the grant terms; we'll route to Total Rewards to confirm. Medical coverage continues as long as you remain enrolled and meet the hours threshold; dropping to 0.75 FTE typically keeps you eligible, but premium share might change. We'll set a benefits review call to check the exact numbers. For equipment: Sam (EngOps) can ship a return label or coordinate pickup; keep it until your last working day unless you want to return earlier.
Payroll Bot: FYI automated: payroll processes regular earnings and PTO the same pay runs. If you have any deferred bonus payments scheduled, those will be paid per their payout date unless specifically deferred by payroll/legal. Email payroll@redwood.com with employee ID and payroll will map exact paycheck dates.
Sam - EngOps: If you're remote, we can mail a return box and label. If you're in SF office and won't be in the office the last day, we can pick up within the week before. Ping me 10 days before your planned final day and we'll arrange. Inventory required: laptop serial, charger, docking station if issued.
Leah P: Thanks — one more: is there a formal blackout window for changing benefits if I do a status change during leave? I don't want to accidentally lose dental coverage or flexible spending enrollment.
Ivy (People Ops): Good call. Changing FTE outside annual open enrollment usually triggers a qualifying life event/plan change window; moving from full-time to part-time due to return-to-work arrangement is a status change event and we can process mid-year. Some voluntary plans (e.g., commuter, FSAs) have specific rules. We'll include that in the benefits call and confirm any deadlines.
Benefits Bot: Reminder: to preserve health coverage during leave, ensure premiums are paid for any unpaid periods. Enrollment change note created  ENR-2026-732.
Ivy (People Ops): Action items for Leah: 1) Submit parental leave request form: https://hr.redwood/leave and tick "use PTO before leave" if you want that applied. 2) Email payroll@redwood.com with your employee ID and the PTO dates you plan to use so payroll can confirm deferrals/match and any bonus timing conflicts. 3) Reply here with planned return FTE (0.75) so we can schedule the benefits/comp check call. 4) @Sam - EngOps will coordinate equipment pickup/shipping.
Leah P: Done, submitted the leave form and emailed payroll. I'll pick a time for the benefits call. Thanks everyone! :heart:
